statements.text: I want to ask about several nondefense AI [artificial intelligence] autonomy organizations, Google and many others, who have now adopted codes of ethics saying they're unwilling to support the use of their technology in defense, for defense purposes. [...] to what extent are you thinking these principles impact DOD's ability to accomplish goals like those set forth in Replicator.
statements.context: Rep. Deluzio questions witnesses at a House Armed Services Committee hearing on DOD's Replicator program.
